title: FR-9: which PR counts as this change's PR
context: Frozen FR-9 says the PR counts as this change's PR only when its head commit is one of the change's own_shas, otherwise the rail shows no PR. Fix commit 46f06075 (src/hud/snapshot.ts:387-400 ownPr) now also keeps two PRs FR-9 would drop: (1) a PR with state merged whose head is a commit recorded in this change's delivery.commits and not inherited, because after a merge-commit merge the base holds the branch tip, own_shas becomes empty and FR-37/INV-10 could never light Merge; (2) a legacy PR saved with no head_sha and no state, kept so the spec edge case 'a delivery.json without pr.state reads Merge as unknown' holds (it reads PR #n, Merge unknown, never merged, never all green). No path lights Merge without pr.state merged, so INV-10 holds. The code matches the spec's intent but not FR-9's literal words.
